# Orca CLI

Honest caveats: the skill is deliberately thin — the real command reference comes from your installed Orca build at runtime, so guidance accuracy depends on keeping Orca updated (`skills get` unknown means an update is due); if a command fails with `runtime_access_denied`, re-run with escalated permissions rather than restarting Orca; and never substitute a different executable when the resolved one fails, since it could silently target a different Orca build. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
